knowledge:
- key_parameters: br=Logical (TRUE/FALSE) indicating whether to use Firth's bias reduction to remedy nonconvergence ;; K.prov=Integer specifying the number of PLS components to use (defaults to the minimum of the row and column rank of the design matrix if not specified) ;; mlogit=Logical (TRUE/FALSE) in glpls1a.mlogit.cv.error to choose between glpls1a.mlogit (TRUE) and glpls1a.logit.all (FALSE)
- alternatives: lda=Linear Discriminant Analysis from the MASS package is mentioned as an alternative classification method ;; glpls1a.logit.all=An alternative to glpls1a.mlogit for multi-group classification that fits separate two-group models, which is simpler but less efficient
- when_to_use: Appropriate for two-group and multi-group classification tasks, especially when dealing with high-dimensional datasets where partial least squares is beneficial, or when standard logistic regression models fail to converge
- pitfalls: The predictor matrix X passed to glpls1a.mlogit must explicitly include a column of ones for the intercept term, whereas the X matrix for glpls1a (two-group) should not include an intercept term ;; glpls1a.logit.all is less statistically efficient than glpls1a.mlogit due to separate fitting of binary logits

workflows.name: two_group_classification
workflows.intent: Fit a two-group classification model using generalized partial least squares and evaluate performance via cross-validation or test set error.
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the two-group model using glpls1a ;; 2. Calculate leave-one-out cross-validation error using glpls1a.cv.error ;; 3. Calculate test set error and predict probabilities using glpls1a.train.test.error

workflows.name: multi_group_classification
workflows.intent: Fit a multi-group classification model using multinomial generalized partial least squares and evaluate performance.
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the multi-group model using glpls1a.mlogit (with intercept) or glpls1a.logit.all (without intercept) ;; 2. Calculate leave-one-out cross-validation error using glpls1a.mlogit.cv.error

workflows.name: formula_interface_classification
workflows.intent: Fit a GPLS classification model using a formula interface and predict classes for new data.
input: Pima.tr (training data frame with predictors and response)
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the model using gpls with formula ;; 2. Predict classes for test data using predict
workflows.code:
m1 = gpls(type~., Pima.tr)
p1 = predict(m1, Pima.te[,-8])
